verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, or any one-click or accelerated wallet checkout. The payments page appears only as a generic title ('Ecommerce Payment Providers & Credit Card Solutions'). The Checkout SDK is a developer building block, not evidence that the platform ships accelerated wallets, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can pay with accelerated wallets — Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, platform one-click — without re-entering details
